items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: Yes, we made some records with Jimmy Durante. In fact, I worked with Jimmy Durante, oh I think it was about, I'd say about three or four months in a place called the College Inn on 125th Street.

ctx.x: That was 1928. Well I was going to ask, there was a, I looked up in a record book just yesterday and they say there's a rumor that you made some early records even with Jimmy Durante and a group that would have had to have been in New York. They were just probably guessing at it. But do you remember, did you ever make any? Yes. In the early 20s. Yes. Did you?

Yes, we made some records with Jimmy Durante. In fact, I worked with Jimmy Durante, oh I think it was about, I'd say about three or four months in a place called the College Inn on 125th Street. Oh really up there?
Yeah. Do you remember when that was?
